question: In what manner should the mantra-knower install Jātavedas across all locations?
premises: It is done together with fire.
inference: The mantra-knower should install Jātavedas together with fire in all places.
uncertainties: The distinction between agni and jātavedas here may be ritual-technical.
plain_english: The knower of mantras should install Jātavedas together with fire in all those places.
